exchangeFormat: FL: RST + FL county. Non-FL US (incl KH6/KL7): RST + state. Canada: RST + province. DX (incl KP4): RST + DXCC prefix. Maritime mobile: RST + ITU region. Phone/CW only (NO digital), 40-10m only (no 160/80/WARC/VHF). FL works everyone; non-FL works FL only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (each counted ONCE PER MODE, regardless of band) [× Power Multiplier — off-log]. Pts: Phone 1/band, CW 2/band. FL entrant mult = 50 states incl FL + DC + 13 Canadian provinces + each DXCC country (outside US/Canada); NO in-state county mult. Non-FL entrant mult = 67 FL counties. FL works everyone for pts; non-FL scores FL contacts only. FL mobiles/expeditions county-change = new QSO + new county credit. Claimed/running — the FCG re-adjudicates. NOT applied (category/self-report, off-log): Power Multiplier (x3 <=5W / x2 <100W / x1 >100W, default x1); Mobile/Expedition 'multipliers once overall' variant (category-dependent — standard per-mode mult is applied); Special 1x1 'no multiplier' variant; Maritime-Mobile ITU-Region (R1/R2/R3) multiplier (rare; resolved as a DXCC-each entity when the MM call classifies DX, else a claimed edge).
